google.name: Google
google.superpower: Search, cloud, Gemini, custom silicon and developer distribution.
google.heel: AI changes the monetization of answers and the route from discovery to transaction.
google.stat: October model update: Gemini 4 Argon. Product reach, paid adoption and infrastructure revenue are separate metrics.

microsoft.name: Microsoft
microsoft.superpower: Enterprise software, developer tools and cloud distribution.
microsoft.heel: Partner dependence, model competition and infrastructure commitments need separate underwriting.
microsoft.stat: Calendar-2026 reported capex is about $175B after lease reclassification; underlying investment expectations are unchanged.

meta.name: Meta
meta.superpower: Social distribution and AI embedded in existing products.
meta.heel: Reach is not the same as paid demand or a chosen-assistant relationship.
meta.stat: Muse Wonder is the October release. No stale model-price or user-count ranking is asserted.

apple.name: Apple
apple.superpower: Devices, operating-system access and on-device computation.
apple.heel: Control of distribution is not a substitute for product execution.
apple.stat: Evaluate actual shipped functionality and partner terms, not an old launch forecast.

xai.name: xAI / SpaceX
xai.superpower: Compute access, consumer distribution and corporate integration.
xai.heel: Integration does not establish enterprise adoption or sustainable serving economics.
xai.stat: Financing, corporate transactions, product use and recognized revenue have different evidence requirements.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA
nvidia.superpower: Accelerators, software, networking and infrastructure partnerships.
nvidia.heel: Customers also develop alternative silicon; challengers need proof of shipment, utilization and economics.
nvidia.stat: Etched’s August $21B financing mark is not equivalent to scaled supply or market share.

amazon.name: Amazon
amazon.superpower: Cloud infrastructure, commerce distribution and the customer transaction.
amazon.heel: Agent-led discovery can change how shoppers encounter sponsored placements.
amazon.stat: Whether value shifts depends on who controls selection, checkout, fulfilment and the customer relationship.
